page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.26xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g6 server family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor built on the x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 104 dedicated physical cores and 104 vCPUs, utilizing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio with no hyperthreading. It is provisioned with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Because there is no bundled local storage, all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing consistent processing capabilities for large-scale workloads.

The hardware profile of the ecs.g6.26xlarge makes it suitable for resource-intensive applications requiring high core counts and a balanced memory-to-CPU ratio. Typical workloads include enterprise application hosting, web serving, containerized microservices, and general-purpose database deployments that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
